title: v1.2.0 - Centered Detail Modal & Agent Logo Navigation
release_notes:
### 🎯 Centered Detail Modal & Agent Logo Navigation

- **Perfect Modal Centering**: Transformed detail modal from bottom-sheet to a balanced, centered card popup on mobile with equal margins and smooth scale animation.
- **Agent Logo Menu**: Replaced text pills in AI Agents quick-jump navigation with 5 clean, single-row circular/squircle brand logo icon buttons.
- **Unified Design System**: Mobile navigation now completely harmonized across Models and AI Agents layers.
